schema_name: Pre-outcome RPT capacity-retention extractor for multi-stage lithium-ion aging
status: frozen before any Stage 1 or Stage 2 numeric CSV data row was opened

authoritative_sources.source: Scientific Data article, Methods and Data Records
facts_used: ET and AT are comprehensive RPTs performed at 10, 45, and 23 degrees Celsius
RPT capacity is the mean of charge and discharge capacity
run_time is time from measurement start in HH:mm:ss.SSS
c_cur is in ampere and is negative during discharge
step_type 21 is the C/2 CCCV capacity charge
step_type 22 is the 1C CCCV capacity discharge

primary_files.initial: exactly one *_ET_T23.csv per mapped cell archive
primary_files.final: exactly one *_AT_T23.csv per mapped cell archive
primary_files.temperature_rule: the companion metadata temperature setpoint must equal 23 degrees Celsius
primary_files.identity_rule: cell identity and stage come only from the frozen archive_file_stage_map.csv; raw internal-serial formatting inside ET and AT metadata cannot alter identity

time_parser.format: HH:mm:ss.SSS with nonnegative integer HH allowed to exceed 23
time_parser.validity: minutes and seconds must be in [0,60); parsed time must be nondecreasing within a file

capacity_extractor.integration: For adjacent rows i and i+1, contribute trapezoidal current only when both rows have the same selected step_type. Q_signed_Ah = sum(0.5*(I_i + I_{i+1})*(t_{i+1} - t_i))/3600.
capacity_extractor.row_filtering: none beyond the frozen step_type selection; no smoothing, clipping, interpolation, outlier deletion, or current-sign replacement
capacity_extractor.block_rule: step_type 21 and 22 must each form exactly one contiguous block; transitions to other steps are never bridged

cell_level_validity: both ET_T23 and AT_T23 files and their metadata companions exist uniquely
required header matches exactly after UTF-8 BOM removal
all run_time, c_cur, and step_type values needed by the selected blocks parse without missing or nonfinite values
selected-block time increments are nonnegative and each block contains at least two distinct timestamps
Q_charge and Q_discharge are finite and strictly positive for ET and AT
missingness: A cell failing any validity item is missing with a reason code; no imputation, endpoint substitution, file substitution, or condition substitution is allowed.
coverage_gate: At least 80 percent of cells must be evaluable overall and at least two cells must be evaluable in every retained Stage 2 condition group in both aging strata.
prespecified_sensitivities: repeat the endpoint with charge capacity only
repeat the endpoint with discharge capacity only
report absolute and relative charge-discharge disagreement at ET and AT
report 10 and 45 degree ET-to-AT retention descriptively when both files pass the same extractor
sensitivity_claim_rule: Sensitivities diagnose robustness and measurement consistency; they cannot replace, rescue, or retune the 23 degree mean-capacity primary endpoint and are outside the two-comparison primary efficacy family.
outcome_access_guard: This schema was frozen from the official article, tables, CSV header lines, ZIP member names, and nonnumeric metadata text. No numeric CSV data row was opened or parsed.
